name: init
description: Initialise the PMLL memory silo for an agent session. Call this once at the start of every agent task, as the 3rd initializer alongside Playwright. Sets up the KV silo and prepares the Q-promise chain for the session.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this agent task (e.g. a UUID).

silo_size.description: Maximum number of KV slots (mirrors memory_silo_t.size).

name: peek
description: Non-destructive context check — the core deduplication primitive. Call this before any Playwright or other MCP tool invocation to check whether the required context already exists in the PMLL silo or is in-flight as a Q-promise.

key.description: The context key to look up.

name: set
description: Store a KV pair in the session's PMLL memory silo. Call after a successful (non-cached) MCP tool invocation to populate the silo so future `peek` calls return a cache hit. Mirrors PMLL.c::update_silo() writing a var/value pair into the silo.

name: flush
description: Clear all short-term KV slots for a session. Call at agent task completion to free memory. Mirrors the teardown of a memory_silo_t allocation (PMLL.c::free_pml).
